      "title": "Keep visible filters active when finish-all fails",
      "evidence": "commandFinishEverything clears filters$ before requesting its fresh snapshot, but leaves filterOptions and the quick-filter UI unchanged. If the snapshot or a subsequent write fails, the component remains on the monitor and displays an error while rows are recomputed without the filters the interface still shows as selected. With auto-check enabled, the newly visible rows are also selected and can receive a subsequent command. The fresh snapshot already supplies finish-all targets independently of rendered filters, so clearing the filter stream is unnecessary.",
